summary: Ran a good-faith counter-evidence pass against all three target claims from counter-evidence-plan.md. Claim 1 (RightNow Media reach): independent proxies (MinistryWatch/IRS Form 990 revenue data, app-store install estimates, a US-congregation denominator) are roughly order-of-magnitude consistent with the 30,000+ churches claim rather than exposing gross inflation; the internal 20,000+/30,000+/32,000 discrepancy remains unreconciled by any source found — reported as weak/low-confidence counter-evidence (0.25). Claim 2 (Planning Center, the brief's headline 'best actionable-now' claim): found genuine new counter-evidence — Planning Center's own current product pages (Services, People, Church Center, checked independently) all state 'Trusted by over 78,000 churches,' contradicting the brief's premise that no current first-party figure exists and sitting closer to the lower Apps Run The World estimate (73,000) than the higher faith.tools estimate (100,000+); a BusinessWire press release confirms a real third-party (Vanco) built and shipped an integration via Planning Center's developer program, partially but not fully answering whether the directory is a real, visible distribution channel for a consumer-facing app; G2/Capterra review-volume data corroborates Planning Center's relative scale lead. Moderate confidence (0.55). Claim 3 (Lifeway Leadership Podcast Network): a good-faith attempt to find independent per-show analytics (Podchaser, Rephonic, Apple ratings) for the network's current show roster came up empty, and general 2026 podcast-industry commentary on download-metric skepticism is genre-level only, not Lifeway-specific — reported honestly as no credible counter-evidence found, low confidence (0.15), consistent with the plan's own instruction that this is a valid, reportable outcome. All three claims received at least one source with independent methodology or a first-hand account per the plan's success criteria; no target claim was found unfalsifiable or the search angles unworkable, so no bounce is warranted.
